goal: Allow node operators to obfuscate, rotate, or remove XOR keys on existing block files without resyncing
Prevent antivirus scanners from misidentifying and deleting block data on nodes synced before v28
agreement: Substantive support with technical objections resolved (sedited, stickies-v)
Approves migration logic and prefers not blocking on GUI launching or lock handling (sedited)
Prefers implementing this as a standalone utility instead of a daemon startup option (stickies-v, luke-jr)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it lets operators protect older datadirs from antivirus deletion without an expensive resync
It provides an optional offline migration that is reasonably deferrable
